blocks.prompt: Three freshmen describe a project they want to do. Which one is IDEA?
Which project are you most looking forward to?
Your group learned the drill press today. Your partner grabs a part and heads for the bandsaw.
You are out sick, excused, for two days. A hook step was due the first day.

criteria.text: Knows what IDEA is, picks a project, and applies the shop and deadline rules

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The aluminum phone stand; any project picked; stop them; two school days later.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One or two of the four count.

blocks.prompt: Your neighbor's site calls them a Visitor and shows no classes. Why?
The bell rings halfway through a post and you close the tab. Tomorrow you open it again.
On the class page, open Music. What does a song cost, in i¢?
Stretch: what you reported through Send feedback

criteria.text: Knows how the site works and can read it for an answer

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A personal Gmail; the answers are saved; the Music price on the class page (2 on 2026-10-28).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Two of the three are right.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the three is right.

blocks.prompt: Screenshot: your folder in the class Armory project

criteria.text: A readable sketch photo and the student's own Armory folder

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The sketch can be made out, and the screenshot shows the student's own folder in the IDEA 100 project.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one is in, the sketch cannot be made out, or the screenshot shows no folder of theirs.

blocks.prompt: Armory shows your teammate has the base part open. You need to change one hole in it.
Your friend sliced their hook and pressed Print plate. What should they have done?

criteria.text: Handles a file a teammate has open, and the print hand-off

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Ask them to save and close it, then open it; export the sliced plate file to the card or drive.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two picks is right.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Neither pick is right, or none is made.
